description: Compare source and destination — Compares source and destination trees, reporting matches, differences, and missing files.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

checkFileFs.description: Remote containing the checksum SUM file when using `checkFileHash`.

checkFileHash.description: Hash name to expect in the supplied SUM file, such as `md5`.

checkFileRemote.description: Path within `checkFileFs` to the checksum SUM file.

combined.description: Set to true to include a combined summary report in the response.

differ.description: Set to true to include differing files in the report.

download.description: Set to true to read file contents during comparison instead of relying on hashes.

dstFs.description: Destination remote name or path that should match the source.

error.description: Set to true to include entries that encountered errors.

match.description: Set to true to include matching files in the report.

missingOnDst.description: Set to true to report files missing from the destination.

missingOnSrc.description: Set to true to report files missing from the source.

oneWay.description: Set to true to only ensure that source files exist on the destination.

srcFs.description: Source remote name or path to verify, e.g. `drive:`.

name: operations_check
